name: VRM_MEA_RULES_B
description: VRM_MEA_RULES_B contains the rules for identification of multiple element arrangements.

columns.name: MEA_RULE_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier of the MEA identification rule.

columns.name: PRIORITY
columns.description: Priority for a MEA identification rule.

columns.name: CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Code name of a MEA classification. Values are derived from VRM_MEA_CLASSIFICATION lookup type.

columns.name: DURATION
columns.description: Specifies the duration in number of days in which all transaction lines for the MEA are created. For transaction lines to be eligible for grouping the duration between the earliest transaction date and the latest transaction date should not be more than the duration specified in this parameter.

columns.name: DEFAULT_MEA_PERIOD
columns.description: The default multiple element arrangement period.

columns.name: DEFAULT_MEA_PERIOD_UNIT
columns.description: The default MEA period unit. Possible values are days, months, and years.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Flag that indicates if the rule is active.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
